scientific_hypothesis: A same-capacity CNN trained on legal multi-context Sample data with context-train-only target scaling and a dynamic predicted-high-tail pairwise logistic objective improves equal-budget T-cell MRL selection relative to the frozen original Sample CNN.
evidence_boundary: Retrospective method development/protocol sensitivity only; historical outer results were previously inspected. Not a new blind test or prospective confirmation.

sample.normalization: Use the previously validated sample2019-fixed-utr-v1 normalized_sequence; require exactly 50 ACGT and finite measured_rl. No varying-length rows.
sample.legal_roles: original_evolution random-library rows in train/development/historical_measured_state_outer, plus designed rows only when original E1_pool_eligible=true. Exclude official seen/boundary, scaler/control/quarantine, unsupported and non-50nt rows.
sample.target_exclusion: Read only utr/UTR sequence keys from both raw T-cell files. Exclude any Sample exact/H1 match and its entire allocation_unit_id before splitting; never access T-cell rl.
sample.split: Deterministic SHA256('tcell_multicontext_backbone_v1|'+allocation_unit_id) integer modulo 10: 0=dev, otherwise train. Existing exact/H1/trajectory allocation components remain intact.
sample.original_ablation_data: Use the unchanged original fresh-CNN train/dev pack, including only its original eGFP unmod r1 and designed roles; no resplit.
sample.target_standardization: For each context independently, mean and population SD from that context's train rows only; zero SD fails. Network outputs remain in standardized score units for zero-shot ranking.

model.parallelism: Three seed processes in parallel after a real CUDA three-process memory probe; queue by seed only if capacity fails.
model.objective: Equal-context total MSE plus lambda times equal-context dynamic-tail pairwise logistic loss. Within each context every pool has equal total pair weight; exact label-tied pairs have zero weight. MSE is weighted so each context has equal total epoch weight.
model.dynamic_tail: At every training and dev batch, detach current predictions only for top16 membership; all 120 ordered-by-index unordered pairs per pool, softplus(-sign(y_i-y_j)*(p_i-p_j)); gradients flow through selected pair scores.
model.convergence: Original DualPlateau on train and dev combined objective, min_delta=0.0001, patience=5; any absolute dev best resets plateau. No maximum epoch.
model.best_epoch: Absolute best dev combined objective; finite train/dev losses and real CUDA required at every epoch.

model_roles.baseline: Frozen original three-member Sample CNN ensemble; no retraining.
model_roles.main: Extended multi-context data, joint MSE+dynamic-tail rank; lambda selected separately from the frozen grid.
model_roles.extended_mse_only: Extended multi-context data, MSE only; preregistered data-attribution ablation.
model_roles.original_mse_tail_rank: Unchanged original train/dev data, joint MSE+dynamic-tail rank; lambda selected separately; preregistered rank-loss-attribution ablation.

auxiliary.refilter: Before any new-model inference, remove every old auxiliary row with exact/H1 match to any extended Sample train/dev sequence. Existing exact/H1 component split assignments and strict target exclusions remain unchanged.
auxiliary.pool_rule: Reuse deterministic SHA256(context|split|sequence) complete nonoverlapping 64-item pools after refiltering.
auxiliary.lambda_selection: For each rank variant independently, ensemble its three seeds and minimize the mean of normalized cap16 regret over all Sample dev contexts and both auxiliary source-inner dev contexts. Normalize each context regret by its own train target SD. Destination dev and test are forbidden. Ties within 1e-12 use dev combined objective then smaller lambda.

gate.ci_requirement: pool-cluster 95% percentile upper strictly below zero in each direction
gate.cluster: destination auxiliary test pool; mean over five seeds before resampling pools

target_if_and_only_if_dual_gate_pass.bootstrap_cluster: 16 repeat-linked pools; both repeats and five proposal seeds move together
success: both repeat cap16 main-minus-baseline mean regret effects are strictly negative
combined repeat-linked block bootstrap 95% percentile CI upper is strictly below zero
combined absolute reduction is at least max(0.1 MRL, 5% of combined baseline regret)
all isolation, finite-loss, real-CUDA, convergence and best-epoch records pass
target_if_and_only_if_dual_gate_pass.ablations: Evaluate both frozen ablation ensembles once at all caps for attribution; they do not relax the main gate or success rule.

verification_rounds: Round 1 raw/input hashes, target-label-blind preparation, exact/H1 allocation and target isolation, focused tests and real CUDA memory probe
Round 2 standalone independent source-inner selection, destination test regret/bootstrap, checkpoint/history/numerical audit without importing training modules
Round 3 clean-process tests, deterministic replay/hash audit, fail-closed target count and local forbidden-export scan
local_export: De-identified aggregates, configs, code, logs, curves and verification only; no sequence strings, per-sequence labels or predictions.
